product.title: Kestrel Alpine Shell Jacket
product.descriptionHtml:
Built for wet alpine starts and long approaches, the Kestrel Alpine Shell Jacket pairs a 3-layer 20,000 mm waterproof laminate with a helmet-compatible hood and pit zips that dump heat on the switchbacks.

  • Use case: alpine climbing, backcountry skiing, storm-day commuting
  • Materials: 3-layer waterproof laminate, fully taped seams
  • Dimensions: packs to 1.1 L in its own chest pouch; weight 13 oz
  • Compatibility: helmet-compatible hood; fits over a puffy mid-layer
  • Limitations: not insulated on its own; no recco reflector

Care: machine wash cold on gentle, tumble low, re-proof with DWR wash-in after ten washes.
